_readme: Single source of truth for what the AI chat and the contact-form auto-reply say about the business. When you change a price or a service here, change the page too, then run `npm run check:offer` from the repo root: it fails if a price below is missing from its page or a page shows a price that is not listed here.
about: AAA Impressions: industrial marketing and bilingual technical documentation for manufacturers, warehouses and contractors.
Based in Vero Beach (Treasure Coast), Florida; works remotely across the US. English and Spanish in-house.
Owner: Adinel Perez Mendez, who personally reviews every request.

items.name: Spec sheets, cut sheets, data sheets and submittal packages under the client's brand
Bilingual safety and compliance communications: HazCom program materials, LOTO visual procedures, forklift training materials in Spanish, workplace posters, pool chemical Spanish labels
items.note: Quoted per facility, machine or site.

items.name: Custom OSHA/ANSI-format safety signs in English and Spanish
Technical translation English to Spanish (manuals, spec sheets, training materials, employee handbooks), laid out ready to print
items.note: Quoted per document. Not certified translation.

items.name: Product content for catalogs and e-commerce (titles, descriptions, spec tables)

prices.text: batch of 25 products in English from $300
Spanish version of the same batch from $150

items.name: Bilingual AI automation (instant replies, chat assistants, follow-ups)

prices.text: setup from $600 plus a flat monthly fee

items.name: Industrial marketing services: B2B websites, Google/Microsoft Ads, industrial branding, LinkedIn and social, business printing (catalogs, line cards, signage)

more_pages.name: Industries served: building materials, electrical and HVAC, plumbing and pool supply, warehousing and logistics

rules: Every project gets a written proposal with scope, timeline and price before work starts.

Compliance content (OSHA, HazCom, LOTO, forklift, FIFRA) is designed from content the CLIENT approves. AAA Impressions does not determine hazards, applicability or legal compliance and never says anything is "certified" or "OSHA-compliant".
Sample files are welcome by email or WhatsApp.
